findings.claim: `src/proto/h1/decode.rs` changes introduce pointer-sized integer boundary behavior in two read-size calculations, which should be reviewed for 32-bit and very large-input cases.
supporting_facts: Evidence reports `usize::try_from(*remaining).unwrap_or(usize::MAX)` as a high-confidence direct semantic integer platform boundary change.
Evidence reports `usize::try_from(*rem).unwrap_or(usize::MAX)` as a high-confidence direct semantic integer platform boundary change.
The production file changed without corresponding test changes, so focused boundary regression coverage is not shown by this evidence set.
findings.limitation: This finding is based only on explicit scanned semantic patterns and missing-test support; it does not prove a runtime bug or cover unscanned decoder semantics.
findings.review_action: Review pointer-sized integer conversion behavior on 32-bit targets and large remaining/rem values; add focused tests or document why existing coverage is sufficient.
